entries.name: 黒紋付羽織袴・白扇を添えて
entries.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE photorealistic full-body transparent cutout of elderly Japanese Kozo in dignified formal attire for a photo compositing app. Reference image 1 is the IDENTITY reference: preserve his exact recognizable wrinkled smiling face, gray hair, glasses, elderly age, skin and natural male body proportions. This remains the SAME elderly Japanese man wearing different clothing, never a different ethnicity, a young model or a different face. Change all original clothes and remove the fishing cap. No wig, face-obscuring veil, youth makeover or exaggerated feminine body. Realistic refined ceremonial clothing, authentic plausible construction, rich fabric texture and tasteful details. Respectful gentle smile and natural formal commemorative pose, eyes toward camera. Single person only, no scene or other people. Entire head, headdress if any, all hands and footwear, ALL hanging sleeves and any robe train or accessories must fit fully inside canvas with generous actual transparent padding at least 40 pixels on ALL sides. Front three-quarter full length view. Soft neutral photographic studio light. Genuine alpha transparent background and garment openings, no studio backdrop, no opaque floor plane, no stage, no gradient, no checkerboard, no halo or glow, only very subtle tight contact shadow if any. Natural hands and five fingers per hand when visible. No readable text, logo, named family or clan crest, military decorations, official rank insignia or weapons. This is a tasteful custom commemorative outfit inspired by formal dress, not a claimed exact museum reconstruction. For all Japanese kimono, normal living-person left-over-right collar overlap, correct obi placement, white split-toe tabi and appropriate zori footwear. Never depict bare feet with Western evening clothes.
Attire and formal pose: Classic BLACK silk crested kimono with matching black haori and silver-black vertically striped hakama, thick white braided haori cord, white tabi and formal zori. Small generic abstract round white floral crests at correct haori positions, not imperial or named-clan insignia. Both hands neatly hold a CLOSED white folding fan horizontally before waist, calm warm smile.
